summary: Configured node1 so new interactive login sessions default to umask 027. The setting persisted across a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Configured pam_umask with umask=027 and nousergroups.
Verified root and non-root interactive login shells create directories as 750 and files as 640.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified recovery.

evidence.requirement: New interactive login sessions use umask 027
evidence.summary: Configuration was installed, and root plus non-root interactive login tests reported umask 0027 with runtime permission assertions passing.

Healthy baseline boot ID 8e0ddb92-5f82-4d03-942e-362c27d766cd was captured, reboot acknowledged, and node1 returned with boot ID ab6db6f2-1ad2-4ef7-873e-e96f9d2fc08e. Required targets, writable storage, configuration, and runtime umask behavior all recovered.
